correctness.rationale: A valid labeling has pairwise nonadjacent zero sites. For each k<n/2 the k induced colour-difference constraints on n−k positive vertices form a forest; there are n/(n−k)·binom(n−k,k) possible zero sets and exactly 2^(n−2k) consistent colourings. When k=n/2 the two alternating zero sets each have two proper two-colourings iff n/2 is even, yielding the exceptional term 4·1_(4|n) t^(n/2). The weighted cyclic matching trace with transfer matrix [[2t,t],[1,0]] adds the correction 2(−1)^(n/2)t^(n/2) for even n. Maximal feasible zeros give exact minimum multiplicities 4/2n/n². Independent direct trinary-label enumeration verified every coefficient for n=3..10, and the source verifier supplies further finite transfer checks; the all-n statement rests on the combinatorial proof.
